name: Olist Business Overview
description: GMV excludes freight; gross paid is not net revenue. AOV = total positive eligible paid amount / paid order count. Dates use America/Sao_Paulo purchase date.
policy:
### Metric policy
Amounts: BRL. Eligible statuses: delivered, shipped, invoiced, processing, approved, created; canceled/unavailable are excluded from money KPIs. GMV excludes freight. Gross paid is observed payments, not net revenue. AOV uses positive-payment eligible orders once; no paid orders gives NULL.

Dates are local purchase dates; start/end are both inclusive. Empty filters show all history. Missing items/payments are reported below.

Data is available after the latest pipeline run succeeds. Check publication status below and refresh after a run. Cards may refresh at different times.

cards.name: GMV (BRL)
cards.query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gmv),0) AS gmv FROM analytics.mart_revenue_daily WHERE TRUE [[AND order_purchase_date >= {{start_date}}]] [[AND order_purchase_date <= {{end_date}}]] HAVING (SELECT available FROM analytics.bi_publication_status)

cards.name: Gross paid amount (BRL)
cards.query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gross_paid_amount),0) AS paid FROM analytics.mart_revenue_daily WHERE TRUE [[AND order_purchase_date >= {{start_date}}]] [[AND order_purchase_date <= {{end_date}}]] HAVING (SELECT available FROM analytics.bi_publication_status)

cards.name: AOV (BRL)
cards.query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(paid_amount)/NULLIF(SUM(paid_order_count),0),2) AS aov FROM analytics.mart_average_order_value WHERE TRUE [[AND order_purchase_date >= {{start_date}}]] [[AND order_purchase_date <= {{end_date}}]] HAVING (SELECT available FROM analytics.bi_publication_status)

cards.name: Eligible orders
cards.query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(eligible_order_count),0) AS eligible FROM analytics.mart_revenue_daily WHERE TRUE [[AND order_purchase_date >= {{start_date}}]] [[AND order_purchase_date <= {{end_date}}]] HAVING (SELECT available FROM analytics.bi_publication_status)

cards.name: Daily GMV and gross paid (BRL)
cards.query: SELECT order_purchase_date,gmv,gross_paid_amount FROM analytics.mart_revenue_daily WHERE TRUE [[AND order_purchase_date >= {{start_date}}]] [[AND order_purchase_date <= {{end_date}}]] AND (SELECT available FROM analytics.bi_publication_status) ORDER BY order_purchase_date

cards.name: Daily AOV (BRL)
cards.query: SELECT order_purchase_date,average_order_value FROM analytics.mart_average_order_value WHERE TRUE [[AND order_purchase_date >= {{start_date}}]] [[AND order_purchase_date <= {{end_date}}]] AND (SELECT available FROM analytics.bi_publication_status) ORDER BY order_purchase_date

cards.name: Order status — all statuses
cards.query: SELECT order_status,COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM analytics.fct_orders WHERE TRUE [[AND order_purchase_date >= {{start_date}}]] [[AND order_purchase_date <= {{end_date}}]] AND (SELECT available FROM analytics.bi_publication_status) GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_count DESC,order_status

cards.name: Eligible order completeness
cards.query: SELECT SUM(eligible_order_count) AS eligible_orders,SUM(orders_without_items) AS orders_without_items,SUM(orders_without_payments) AS orders_without_payments FROM analytics.mart_revenue_daily WHERE TRUE [[AND order_purchase_date >= {{start_date}}]] [[AND order_purchase_date <= {{end_date}}]] HAVING (SELECT available FROM analytics.bi_publication_status)
